ValidationRule.description: Opportunity credit is locked when opportunity is lock.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( NSP_Opportunity__r.StageName , "Closed Won" ) , NOT( $Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.OpportunityValidations__c ) , AND( $UserRole.DeveloperName != "New_Client_Sales" , $UserRole.DeveloperName != "Sales_Compensation" , $UserRole.DeveloperName != "Sales_Administrator" ) , AND( $Profile.Name <> 'Data Migration' , $Profile.Name <> 'Integration User' , NOT( CONTAINS( $Profile.Name , 'System Admin' ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Once Opportunity is Closed Won it cannot be modified. Please contact Sales Operations team
